Check Point warns of zero-day flaw exploited for root access
picks.summary: Check Point Software has released emergency hotfixes to address a high-severity flaw that hackers have been exploiting to gain root privileges and establish persistence on vulnerable devices since late October. [...]

picks.title: Attackers in Binance Breach Targeted Known Weakness, Missing Controls
picks.summary: Blockchain complexities (such as attacker-deployed sweepers) hobble security controls designed to limit the damage of an exchange compromise.

picks.title: 1994 Jeep Cherokee owner hacks 32-year-old car with Claude AI to pass California smog tests
picks.summary: An AI enthusiast managed to get his old 1994 Jeep Cherokee to pass the California smog tests thanks to the help of AI, a little electronics wiring skill, and $15 of components.

picks.title: DOJ moves to seize $1.2 billion from Binance hack, disrupts North Korean deepfake scheme
picks.summary: DOJ got court approval to seize $1.2B stolen from Binance by North Korea s TraderTraitor & took down the FaceStealer deepfake scam.

picks.title: Binance Says Hack Assets Covered, Reserve Proof Pending
picks.summary: The exchange says it has closed the remaining gap in customer backing, but users must wait for the new snapshot s cryptographic proof to verify it.
